```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r plots, include=FALSE}
vaccine_name <- "zostavax"
source(glue::glue("analysis/specify_paths.R"))
source(glue::glue("analysis/{vaccine_name}/7_plot_scatter.R"))
source(glue::glue("analysis/{vaccine_name}/8_plot_annual_fup.R"))
source(glue::glue("analysis/{vaccine_name}/9_plot_sensitivity.R"))
source(glue::glue("analysis/{vaccine_name}/10_plot_thresholdyr.R"))
source(glue::glue("analysis/{vaccine_name}/11_plot_altoutcome.R"))
source(glue::glue("analysis/{vaccine_name}/12_plot_descriptives.R"))
```

These results are strictly confidential and can only be shared with project team. 

This report has been generated using data release [01M6ZX7A7Y3BVKF91JSGDYK5XN](https://jobs.opensafely.org/the-effect-of-herpes-zoster-vaccines-on-incident-dementia-in-england/zostavax-dementia/releases/01M6ZX7A7Y3BVKF91JSGDYK5XN/).

This report does not include patient characteristics, which were missing from the release, and the threshold year analyses, which need to be corrected.

## MSE-optimal bandwidth

The MSE-optimal bandwidth was derived using dementia as the outcome and was used in all analyses included in this report, unless otherwise specified. `h` specifies the main bandwidth used to construct the regression discontinuity point estimator, while `b` specifies the bias bandwidth used to construct the bias-correction estimator.

```{r msebw, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
df_msebw <- read.csv(glue::glue(
  release_dir,
  "{vaccine_name}/setup/rd_msebw.csv"
))

knitr::kable(
  df_msebw,
  digits = 1
)
```
